Package edu.ntnu.stud.idatg2003.backend.mathoperations

Class Complex

java.lang.Object
edu.ntnu.stud.idatg2003.backend.mathoperations.Vector2D
edu.ntnu.stud.idatg2003.backend.mathoperations.Complex
public class Complex extends Vector2D
The Complex class represents a complex number, with a real and imaginary part. It extends the Vector2D class, and inherits mathematical operations from it. The real and imaginary parts represent the components of the complex number.

A complex number is represented as z = a + bi, where a is the real part and b is the imaginary part.

Since:
0.0.0 (The version of Chaos-Game application when introduced)

  • Method Details

    • multiply

      public Complex multiply(Complex other)
      Multiplies this complex number with the given complex number.

      The multiplication of two complex numbers (a + bi) and (c + di) is given by:
      (a + bi) * (c + di) = (ac - bd) + (ad + bc)i

      Parameters:
      other - The complex number to multiply with.
      Returns:
      The result of the multiplication.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the other complex number is null.
      Since:
      0.0.0

    • sqrt

      public Complex sqrt()
      Calculates the square root of this complex number.

      The square root of a complex number z = a + bi is calculated as follows: Let r be the magnitude (r = sqrt(a^2 + b^2)) and theta be the angle (theta = atan2(b, a)). The square root is then given by:
      sqrt(z) = sqrt(r) * (cos(theta / 2) + i * sin(theta / 2))

      Returns:
      The result of the square root as a new Complex number.
      Since:
      0.0.0

    • subtract

      public Complex subtract(Vector2D otherVector)
      Subtracts the given vector from this complex number. If the other vector is also a complex number, the subtraction is performed on the real and imaginary parts separately.

      The subtraction of two complex numbers (a + bi) and (c + di) is given by:
      (a + bi) - (c + di) = (a - c) + (b - d)i

      Overrides:
      subtract in class Vector2D
      Parameters:
      otherVector - The vector to subtract from this complex number.
      Returns:
      A new complex number representing the result of the subtraction.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the other vector is null.
      Since:
      0.0.2

    • pow

      public Complex pow(double exponent)
      Raises this complex number to the power of the given exponent.

      The power of a complex number z = a + bi to the exponent n is calculated as follows: Let r be the magnitude (r = sqrt(a^2 + b^2)) and theta be the angle (theta = atan2(b, a)). The power is then given by:
      z^n = r^n * (cos(n * theta) + i * sin(n * theta))

      Parameters:
      exponent - The exponent to raise this complex number to.
      Returns:
      The result of the power as a new Complex number.
      Since:
      0.0.3

      public double angle()
